name: Scrambleverse — each nonland permanent goes to the player rolled for it
notes: Sweep group 6 (2026-10-07). "For each nonland permanent, choose a player at random. Then each player gains control of each permanent for which they were chosen." produced nothing. Casting the spell now rolls a player for each nonland permanent on the board it was cast into (kept on the spell as _rolledControllers and saved with the board; the outcome is written into the effect's description). queueRandomPicks fixes the rolls here: Grizzly Bears → opponent, Gray Ogre → you, Hill Giant → opponent. The Forest is a land and stays.
